resource_rule.measure: Sum of libproc resident bytes rounded up per member to KiB over owned process group; sampled, not continuous peak
resource_rule.failure: Stop above 40 GiB, after three consecutive unavailable observations, or immediately after a sampler timeout; retain all partial evidence. Unknown native/group exit blocks every subsequent child.

semantics.schedule: Graph seed then sampling seed then case then adjacent half/eighth children. Graph seed two reverses case order. Variant order reverses when graph-index plus sampler-index is odd. Six timed repetitions balance solver positions within every child.
semantics.timing_boundary: Original tuple-input/native-result boundaries. KKT and both Boruvka continuations time problem conversion and temporary input destruction; returned-result validation/destruction are outside the interval. UTC/CPU envelopes are slightly wider than steady elapsed.
semantics.comparison: Pair all six half/eighth solver durations by case, graph seed, sampling seed and repetition; compare KKT directly with all five controls within each variant. Case medians pool 24 paired ratios; four graph/sampler realization medians use six each; graph and sampler marginal medians use twelve each. Both clocks, all trials and losses remain included.
semantics.purpose: Test private scalar sampling with acceptance mask 7 instead of mask 1, with compressed verifier queries fixed in both fresh variants. The same compressed verifier object, six other non-KKT objects and harness object are shared. Only eighth kkt.o selects EIGHTH_SAMPLING; both variants contain the same pure-predicate refactor. Public sampling remains the legacy scalar half stream. Both policies draw once per edge and reserve m/2. Private samples and recursive work differ; identical cumulative counters across rates are neither expected nor required. No packed sampling, set-bit iteration, reserve change or historical timing pooling. Smaller samples can weaken filtering; no speedup is assumed.
semantics.clock_semantics: Steady elapsed and process CPU remain separate. Clock flags are descriptive, never a reason to trim or correct data. UTC reversals remain in raw endpoints. Power-log correlation uses actual Sleep/Wake/DarkWake transitions; Wake Requests do not close sleep.
semantics.power_semantics: No verified sleep inhibition is inferred. An absent logged overlap is not proof of an awake, quiet host. Power auditing is post-capture only and never launches pmset automatically.
semantics.certificate_scope: Independent native reference certificate once per child, then exact unique-MST ID/tuple validation for every warmup and timed call.
semantics.crossover: For each variant/family/control, all four graph/sampler realization medians on both clocks must exceed one at the smaller endpoint and be at most 9/10 at the larger endpoint. Medians and thresholds are reconstructed as exact Fractions of integer endpoints. Keep all 30 classifications, including narrow leads, mixed outcomes and reversals. Two endpoints do not establish persistence beyond the measured larger size or an asymptotic crossover.

power_audit.limitation: External log provided; query success/retention coverage not established here. No raw private power events are copied into analysis.

aggregation: Pair all six half/eighth solver durations by case, graph seed, sampling seed and repetition; compare KKT directly with all five controls within each variant. Case medians pool 24 paired ratios; four graph/sampler realization medians use six each; graph and sampler marginal medians use twelve each. Both clocks, all trials and losses remain included.
